purpose: Development-set feasibility; not a validated PICKUP detector
inputs: Exact frozen Uniform8 PNGs only, native source PTS, no nearest substitution

camera.method: Sparse LK background flow and RANSAC homography, excluding detected person/phone/ball boxes

motion.interpretation: Image-relative diagnostic only; not physical support, lift, or pickup

local_consistency.meaning: Tentative local association only; no persistent identity, no association across gaps or classes

physical_state.UNKNOWN: Any required physical observation missing, uncalibrated, contradictory, or insufficient continuity. No known contact/support classifier is available: unavailable primitives remain null, not fabricated confidence values.
prohibited_shortcuts: stationary image projection as mechanical support

evaluation_separation: Runtime must not open human review, GT, or call outputs. Save both windows computed states and all candidate objects, seal receipt, then compare human review in a separate reporting step. Investigator already knows historical DEV outcomes: this is not blind validation.
checkpoint: PASS requires plausible independent correctly targeted phone pickup evidence AND discrimination of false ball attribution; partial if only one; blocked if neither is established. No lowering criteria to obtain PASS.
stop: No Qwen, no final Decision layer, no Graph writes, no commit/push. Stop at signal checkpoint.
